title: Imeti in iti: imam, grem
description: The two verbs you use all day: imeti (to have) and the irregular iti (to go), with the negatives nimam and ne grem.

quest.story: Mojca gre jutri v Ljubljano in nima časa za šolo. Pokaži ji, da znaš 'imam' in 'grem'. · Mojca is going to Ljubljana tomorrow and has no time for school. Show her you know 'imam' and 'grem'.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: imeti: imam, imaš, ima, imamo, imate, imajo. Regular, like delam.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: ti → greš. Kam = where to (direction); kje = where (place).

exercises.instruction: Katere so oblike glagola iti? · Which are forms of iti (to go)?
exercises.explain: iti is irregular: grem, greš, gre, gremo, greste, gredo. The others are forms of imeti.

exercises.text: Otroci ___ v šolo. (The children are going to school.)
exercises.explain: oni → gredo (standard); grejo is what you hear in everyday speech. V šolo = to school (direction).

exercises.text: Ali ___ kavo? (Do you have coffee? — to a friend)
exercises.explain: ti → imaš. Kava → kavo: the object goes into the accusative.

exercises.text: Danes ___ časa. (Today I don't have time.)
exercises.explain: ne + imam fuses into nimam (nimaš, nima, nimamo, nimate, nimajo). After it, čas → časa (genitive).

exercises.text: Jutri ___ v službo, je nedelja. (Tomorrow I'm not going to work, it's Sunday.)
exercises.explain: Most verbs simply take 'ne' in front: ne grem, ne delam. Only biti, imeti and hoteti fuse: nisem, nimam, nočem.

exercises.prompt: We are going to the market.
exercises.explain: mi → gremo. Na tržnico: direction, so the accusative -o.

exercises.prompt: Today I don't have a car.
exercises.explain: nimam is one word, and after it avto → avta (genitive after negation).
sestra → dve sestri (dual). Slovene usually drops jaz.

exercises.prompt: Are you going home? (to a friend)
exercises.explain: ti → greš. Domov = home (where to); doma = at home.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that tomorrow you are going to Gorizia.
exercises.explain: grem = I go. V Gorico: direction, accusative -o.
